data.comparison_design: as the record: per hemisphere-structure, each pair of brains (pairwise_subjects; the rows the paper quotes) and each brain vs the single-rater template GT (subject_vs_GT); no consensus label

definitions.axes: template grid is axis-aligned RAS at 0.25 mm: x = left->right, y = posterior->anterior (blockface/histology section axis, labels drawn every 1.2 mm), z = inferior->superior
definitions.surface: mask voxels with a background 6-neighbor (m & ~binary_erosion(m)), as overlap_h7.py
definitions.assd_mm: mean of the pooled directed surface-to-surface EDT distances (both directions), as overlap_h7.py
definitions.hd95_mm: 95th percentile of the same pooled symmetric surface distances (primary HD95)
definitions.hd95_max_directed_mm: max of the two directed 95th percentiles (the MONAI-style HD95), for comparison
definitions.centroid_offset_mm_signed: centroid(b) - centroid(a) in world mm per axis (b = second brain, or GT)
definitions.one_voxel_dice_thinnest_axis_of_record: label_refs.one_voxel_ref (the rule of record: integer one-voxel shift along the grid axis closest to the PCA-thinnest axis, mean of +/-)
definitions.one_voxel_dice_per_axis: Dice of the label vs itself shifted one voxel along that axis, mean of +/-
definitions.one_voxel_assd_mm_direction_averaged: ASSD of the label vs itself shifted one voxel, mean over the six shifts (HD95 likewise)
definitions.pair_reference: each row's references are the mean of its two labels' references (as the record's one_voxel_ref.mean)
definitions.dice_vs_shift_direction_averaged: self-Dice at an integer shift of k voxels, mean over the six axis directions
definitions.equivalent_shift_mm_direction_averaged: shift (mm) at which the row's mean direction-averaged self-Dice curve equals the observed Dice (linear interpolation between integer shifts; None beyond 4 voxels)
definitions.reproduction: all 24 demons rows' dice/assd_mm/centroid_mm/voxel counts and all 16 thinnest-axis references of the record were recomputed from the same files and asserted equal to rounding

paper_text_reference_note.note: results_histology.tex quotes Dice from labels_overlap_s125 but the one-voxel reference from labels_overlap.json (the earlier labels/push carry), not the s125 file's own reference
